can I apply more?

blocks.trans1: A) Even if you do not experience irritation upon first use, the skin's adaptation reaction to retinal can appear later. Even if no reaction occurs, please do not increase the amount or frequency of use, and we recommend following the proper usage instructions for the first 2 weeks.
Q) What are the symptoms of skin adapting to retinal?

blocks.sourceKo:
A) 레티날을 처음사용한다면2주까지피부
적응 과정을 가져야 합니다.
적응기간동안일시적으로붉어짐,각질탈락,
간지러움,화끈거림,따가움등의 피부 반응이
나타날 수 있습니다.
blocks.trans1:
A) If you are using retinal for the first time, your skin needs an adjustment period of up to 2 weeks.
During this adaptation period, temporary skin reactions such as redness, flaking, itching, a burning sensation, or stinging may occur.
Q) Can pregnant women use it?
A) We do not recommend use for pregnant or breastfeeding women, as hormonal changes during this time make the skin more sensitive.
